title: VMMU: A Vietnamese Multitask Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Randomly shuffling the order of multiple-choice answer options to measure changes in model accuracy and evaluate sensitivity to option ordering.
Evaluating models on questions without providing the required visual evidence to detect reliance on text-only priors, memorization, and guessing heuristics.

Comparing model performance on native Vietnamese text versus English-translated text paired with the same visual evidence to assess whether models are overly reliant on English-centric training for multimodal reasoning.
